description.value:
You have derived a set of powers from technical schematics, cast with the aid of your wristpad. General techcasting rules appear in chapter 10, and the tech powers list in chapter 12.

Tech Powers Known. You start knowing 3 tech powers of your choice, learning more as you level up per the Tech Powers Known column of the Rakatan Order Techcasting table. You cannot learn a power whose level exceeds your Max Power Level.

Tech Points. Your pool of tech points equals half your monk level (rounded up), per the Tech Points column of the table, plus your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (your choice); you spend these to cast tech powers and regain them all after a short or long rest.

Max Power Level. Some tech powers can be overcharged by spending more points for a stronger effect, up to a maximum level that rises with your levels per the table. You may cast a power at 4th level only once between long rests, regaining the ability to do so after resting.

Techcasting Ability. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as your techcasting ability; use it whenever a power refers to that ability, including for setting its save DC and for attack rolls.

Tech save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your techcasting ability modifier

Tech attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your techcasting ability modifier

Techcasting Focus. You use a wristpad as your techcasting focus.
